query: A signed-cookie session restores its data directly from the session key. Locate the session backend loader and the signing utility it uses to deserialize and check the cookie.
Before a model file field delegates an upload name to storage, it checks whether the generated filename is valid. Locate the field method and the file-name validation utility it calls.
A generic model-editing view builds a form class when fields are configured. Locate the view mixin's form-class selection and the model-form factory it invokes.
When a naive datetime is prepared for a model field with time-zone support active, locate the field preparation step and the timezone helper that makes it aware.
